basis: each mutation removes or contradicts one load-bearing property and asserts the factory refuses

mutations.expectation: the factory refuses to render a source whose hash does not match its pin
a form stating it is not for filing raises NonFilingHoldError and produces no fill
the sheet refuses when the filled panel is not the finalized artifact
a value that cannot be drawn at 6pt is refused, not clipped
no bound field matches a protect rule
